svg.title: PD control of the shaft
svg.desc: With Kp 16 and Kd 7 the shaft reaches 1 radian without overshoot and stays within 0.02 radians from 1.52 seconds, while P alone swings; differentiating the error requests 366 newton-metres at the first sample, clipped to the drive's 20, against 16 with the derivative on the measurement.
svg.text: Control Studio validation runs on the actual ST · 1 rad step · 20 ms samples · numbers answer the predictions
PD with the derivative on the error (γ = 1)
At rest: no torque from D
